greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maanta maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya, sawir ka duwan kuwii aan hore uga wada hadalnay. Waxaan arkaa diyaarad yar oo ay ku qoran tahay 'Con Chim Airlines' oo si tartiib ah ugu dul heehaabaysa daruuraha. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya, isagoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan iftiin iyo qorshayaal mustaqbal. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida hawl-qabad weyn, laakiin wuxuu ahaa mid si qoto dheer ugu tiirsan xigmadda Ilaah.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Maahmaahyada, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Erey kasta oo Ilaah wuu tijaabsan yahay; isagu waa gaashaan kuwa magangala.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil magangalay gaashaankaas. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay in waxa adduunkan lagu cabbiro—lacag, guul, iyo xitaa caafimaad—aysan ahayn waxa dhabta ah ee qofka ka dhiga qof weyn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil weydiiyay Ilaah, sida qoraagu weydiiyay: 'I sii cunnada aan u baahanahay.' Ben wuxuu fahmay in nolosha ay tahay hanti yar oo la inoo dhiibay si aan ugu adeegno kuwa kale.

Saddex bilood ayaa laga joogaa tan iyo markii Ben uu u gudbay nolosha kale. Waxaan ogahay in gurigiina uu leeyahay aamusnaan aan la sharxi karin. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Ciise oo u diraya xertiisa inay tagaan iyagoon qaadan waxba: 'Ha qaadanina wax safarka ah, ul, iyo boorso, iyo cunto, iyo lacag toona.' Tani waa cashar adag. Waa cashar ku saabsan inaan ku tiirsanaano oo kaliya Ilaah. Ben, intii uu noolaa, wuxuu ahaa mid si xor ah u bixiyay jacaylkiisa. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. 

Waxaan rabaa inaan idinku dhiirrigeliyo inaad u oggolaataan in naxariista Ilaah ay bogsiiso qalbiyadiinna. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. U oggolow inuu kula fadhiisto, kula cuno, oo kula qaybsado xanuunkaaga. Ciise ma aha mid iska fogeeya kuwa murugaysan; wuxuu u yimid inuu la fadhiisto. Wuxuu rabaa inuu noqdo dhakhtarkaaga maanta.

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sacrament-ka. Waxaan kugu duubayaa naftayda, oo waxaan ku weydiinayaa inaad weligaa ila joogto. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: In Rabbigu uu Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan kuwa naga horreeyay ee dhintay uu u furo albaabbada Jannada, si ay u nastaan iftiinka wejigiisa.
In Rabbigu uu qalbi-qaboojiyo dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan waalidka iyo walaalka Ben, si ay u helaan rajo iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha iyagoo ku kalsoon jacaylka Ilaah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Erey kasta oo Ilaah wuu tijaabsan yahay; isagu waa gaashaan kuwa magangala. Waxba ha ku darin ereyadiisa, waaba intaasoo uu ku canaantaa, oo lagugu ogaadaa inaad beenaale tahay. Laba shay ayaan kaa baryayaa; ha ii diidin intaanan dhiman: Been iyo hadal been ah iga fogee; ha i siin saboolnimo iyo taajirnimo toona; i sii cunnada aan u baahanahay; waaba intaasoo aan dhergo, oo aan ku diido, anigoo leh, 'Yaa Rabbiga ah?' ama waaba intaasoo aan sabool noqdo, oo aan wax xado, oo aan magaca Ilaahayga ku gefo.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Ka fogee xaggaaga jidka beenta ah, oo igu sharf sharcigaaga. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Sharciga afkaaga ayaa iiga qaalisan kun lacag iyo dahab ah. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, wuu raagaa weligiis; wuxuu u adag yahay sida samooyinka. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Jid kasta oo shar ah ayaan cagaheyga ka ceshadaa, si aan u xajiyo ereyadaada. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Amarradaada ayaan wax ku gartaa; sidaas daraaddeed ayaan u necebahay jid kasta oo been ah. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii. Been ayaan necebahay oo aan ka xumaadaa; sharcigaaga ayaan jeclahay. R. Ereygaaga, Rabbiyow, waa laambad u ah cagaheygii.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu u yeedhay laba iyo tobankii, wuxuuna siiyey awood iyo amar ay ku maamulaan jinniyada oo dhan iyo inay bogsiistaan cudurrada, wuxuuna u diray inay ku wacdiyaan boqortooyadii Ilaah iyo inay bogsiistaan kuwa buka. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'Ha qaadanina wax safarka ah, ul, iyo boorso, iyo cunto, iyo lacag toona, oo yaan qofna qaadanin funaanad labaad. Gurigii aad gashaanba, halkaas jooga, oo halkaas ka dhoofa. Oo kuwii aan idin soo dhoweynin, markaad magaaladaas ka dhooftaan, boodhka cagihiinna ka ruxa marag ahaan iyaga ka gees.' Markaasay baxeen, oo waxay mareen tuulo ilaa tuulo, iyagoo wacdiyaya injiilka oo bogsiinaya cudurradii meel kasta.

day: Memorial of Saint Pius of Pietrelcina, Priest

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
